purpose: Perform one action while also doing another.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
ます-stem + ながら + main action.
I cook while listening to music.
I looked for the route while consulting a map.
formation: ます-stem + ながら + main action.
restrictions: The actions ordinarily share a subject; the final action is the main one.
mistake: This simultaneous use differs from concessive ながら meaning although.

segments.role: Perform one action while also doing another. ます-stem + ながら + main action.
